name: Abū Manṣūr ʿAbd al-Malik ibn Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl al-Thaʿālibī
summary: Man of letters of Nishapur, pupil of Abū Bakr al-Khwārazmī, author of Yatīmat al-dahr and Fiqh al-lugha.
bio: Ibn al-Anbārī calls al-Thaʿālibī an excellent man of letters, eloquent and articulate, a pupil of Abū Bakr al-Khwārazmī, and names Yatīmat al-dahr, Siḥr al-balāgha, Farāʾid al-qalāʾid and Sirr al-adab among his many books.
He lived in Nishapur and died there in 429/1038.
uncertain: Ibn al-Anbārī gives no year of death; 429/1038 is the date in TDV.

sources.title: Ibn al-Anbārī, Nuzhat al-alibbāʾ fī ṭabaqāt al-udabāʾ (Cairo 1294/1877), pp. 436–437
Seâlibî, Ebû Mansûr, TDV İslâm Ansiklopedisi
